inputs.text: Hey, this lawsuit is exposing how ICE lawyers were feeding false info to justify rounding up and detaining thousands right after they showed up at immigration courts. They've been leaning on that agency memo from May of last year as cover, but the documents admit it gave no authorization whatsoever. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to target people trying to gain legal status the moment they walk out of those courts. That sudden admission in the filing is just another layer of narrative control, meant to frame it as some isolated mistake while the real operation keeps running under the surface. They always invert the story like this to hide the bigger pattern from the public.
